title: promise.due@1
description: A promised check's wake-up came due (#120), and which route carries it: a wake of the idle session, or the session's row and its next prompt or stop, where no route wakes it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

promise.description: The promise's ID, the same on every event about it.

route.description: wake: the session's waiter wakes it now; next_hook: the row shows it due and its next prompt or stop carries it.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
